quotes: Entity Structure
This section confirms the type of entity being registered in DIFC.
This field cannot be edited.
Information Required
The business sector of your principal activity.
The type of setup (new entity, branch, or transfer from another jurisdiction).
The legal structure (select Company).
The company type (select Private Company).
A minimum of 1 Shareholder.
A minimum of 1 Director.
The issued share capital must be greater than 0.
Your capacity in relation to the entity being registered.
Entity Background
This section asks you to confirm whether the entity being registered has a parent entity.
You are also required to provide an overview of the entity being established in the DIFC
The ownership structure
The activities to be carried out from the DIFC
The target markets
Business model
The type of clients the entity intends to serve
you must disclose whether the entity has any affiliates in the DIFC or in other UAE free zones.
Business Activities
Select the business activities that the proposed entity will carry out.
Please note that some activities require additional approval from relevant government authorities.
Entity Name
Enter the proposed name of the entity.
Comply with the DIFC Naming Policy
Reflect the business activity to be carried out by the entity.
Share Capital
For each share class, you must provide the following details
This can be class A, B or other values.
The number of issued shares
The currency such as AED, USD etc.
The nominal value per share
Stakeholders
A private company must appoint the following stakeholders
The director must be 18 years of age or over.
At least one senior management representative
The appointment of a company secretary is optional.
DIFC requires passport certification for certain roles
Digital verification through the DIFC Portal
Certified passport copy upload
Share Allocation
If the proposed entity has only one shareholder, all shares will be allocated automatically by default.
Third Party Funding
you must provide Passport details (for individual funders), Entity details (for body corporate funders) and Source of income details.
Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs)
Holds 25% or more of the shares or ownership interest in the company.
Where no natural person meets any of the above criteria, each director of the company is deemed as a UBO.
Registered Address
This section will be displayed only if the entity has indicated that it will share office space with an affiliated entity within DIFC.
Contact Details
This section requires you to add at least one contact under each of the categories listed below.
General Communication Contact
Emergency Contact
Compliance Contact
the same individual may be appointed to all three contact categories
Data Protection
you must select the type of Data Protection notification applicable to the entity.
To inform the Commissioner of Data Protection that the entity processes personal data
To inform the Commissioner of Data Protection that the entity does not process personal data
If the entity intends to hire employees or provide services to customers
you must also provide the details of a designated contact person responsible for data protection
Open a Bank Account
This is an optional step, which allows you to consent to the secure sharing of your application data directly with Mashreq Bank
Additional Details
the entity may indicate its preferred or potential office location if the final location has not yet been confirmed.
Articles of Association (AoA)
DIFC provides a standard Articles of Association template, which is automatically generated by the portal.
Establishment Card (Optional)
you may indicate whether the entity intends to apply for employment visas immediately upon licence issuance.
Fit and Proper Questionnaire
Complete the standard Fit and Proper Questionnaire.
Review and submit
You will also be able to view the applicable price line items for setting up the entity in DIFC.
No payment is required at this stage.
Upload a clear copy of the passport, ensuring that the personal details page is fully visible
only if the passport has not been certified through digital verification on the DIFC Portal
address to complete a liveness check
Upload a curriculum vitae (CV) or brief biography of the individual shareholder.
for individual stakeholders appointed as shareholders and Directors
Upload a curriculum vitae (CV) or brief biography of each UBO
For individual funders: provide a bank statement covering the most recent six months.
Upload financial evidence of funding for the proposed entity
Upload a signed copy of the generated document for each Director.
This document is automatically generated by the portal for each Director added to the application.
If any of the documents are not in English, they must be accompanied by a legal translation certified to the satisfaction of the Registrar of Companies
Upload the group ownership structure diagram
Required if the proposed entity has a parent entity
Upload letter of consent issued by the hosting company in DIFC.
Required if the proposed entity will be sharing office space with one of its affiliates
Upload related trust deeds or similar documents.
Upload an official letter issued by the entity whose name is identical to the proposed entity name
Required if the proposed entity name is identical to the name of an existing entity that is not its affiliate or parent
Upload a valid and notarised Power of Attorney confirming the delegation of authority.
where an individual shareholder has authorised another person to sign the Articles of Association on their behalf
Upload a certificate of incorporation or an equivalent official document for each body corporate
for Body Corporate Shareholders only
you must upload a Statement of the Incorporators, signed by all incorporators, confirming the adoption of the modified articles.
Document(s): Investment arrangement or similar document
Upload the approval document or the No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the relevant government authority.
For Innovation license * $1,500
For Innovation license $100
An additional fee of AED 20 is applicable for Knowledge and innovation fees
Discounted DP fees of $250 for year 1 and $200 for following years will apply for Innovation License entities
We recommend accessing the form directly on the portal in advance to familiarise yourself with the required fields.
the application must be submitted through the DIFC Portal.
applicants will receive an initial approval email from DIFC, typically within 3 to 5 working days
